Anni Rage Fist hit only once => ~100BP. Anni chained Protect turns 4-5 (3rd likely fails; chains Protects under double pressure). Basc LO Adaptability: Last Respects scales +50/fainted ally (now 150BP w/ 2 dead) — biggest nuke, watch switch-ins; Aqua Jet +1 priority. Leftovers Anni heals 6%/turn, don't leave it low without finishing. Speed (no TW): Gengar 178 > Anni 110-142 > Basc 98-130 > King 70; TW makes Gengar/King outspeed all. Wincon: TW up, kill Anni with SB/Moonblast, King Sucker cleans Basc (fails only vs Protect — use Kowtow if Protect suspected). Whims has NO Protect — don't sack it needlessly; Stun Spore Basc if free turn.

reflections.adjustment: Exploit the Protect-chain tendency earlier: once Annihilape Protected on turn 4, the turn-5 second Protect was highly predictable — redirect Gengar's Shadow Ball into the unprotected Basculegion instead of firing into Protect. That chips Basc early, denies Leftovers recovery, and makes the endgame KO even safer. Keep the same bring and the Anni-first, Kingambit-last structure.
reflections.notebook: Opponent tendencies: chains Protects on threatened mons under double pressure (streak 2+ is reliable); spends priority (Aqua Jet/Extreme Speed) to finish low-HP targets; preserves Annihilape as anti-Kingambit wincon at all costs. Game 3 bring: Floette-Mega/Arcanine-H/Anni/Basc; Dragapult+Maushold left home. Verified: Whims Moonblast (~39%) + Gengar Shadow Ball (60-71% of max) KOs Basculegion from ~80% with no crit needed (confirmed turn 7). Kingambit 1v1s Basculegion (resists Water+Ghost; Adamant BG Sucker w/ Supreme Overlord ~90-105%; Kowtow if Protect suspected). Anni falls to Gengar Shadow Ball + Whims Moonblast double super-effective coverage. Plan: delete Anni first with Gengar/Whims, preserve Kingambit for endgame; when opponent starts a Protect chain, redirect the second attacker's hit to the unprotected slot rather than hitting into Protect again. Treat Blaziken-Mega as trade piece/priority bait vs double-priority teams, not a sweeper; it should faint before Kingambit.
